reports.title: Reports and moderation
reports.subtitle: Triage user reports and resolve them with neutral moderation actions.
reports.headerSearchPlaceholder: Search title or reason… (ID, reporter, and entity search are not supported)
reports.detailEmpty: Select a report to inspect it.
reports.confirmCopy: Resolving applies the selected consequence now and records this note in the report and affected-item history. System notices depend on recipient preferences and may not be delivered. User/organization reports resolved with no action may still suspend the target while the suspend-on-report setting is on.
reports.confirmRequired: Confirm the consequences above to enable Resolve.
reports.resolutionPlaceholder: State what was decided and why…
reports.resolutionRequired: A resolution note is required when applying an action.
reports.actionIncompatible: This action does not apply to this report target.
reports.resolveConflict: The report changed state. Refresh and try again.
reports.confirmedDescription: The report and the affected item were re-read and match the decision.
reports.unconfirmedDescription: The decision was sent but the re-read does not show it yet. Refresh to verify.
reports.noticeSuppressed: Notice accepted but not delivered (recipient preferences).

settings.title: Platform Settings
settings.subtitle: Platform-wide defaults, digest delivery, moderation flags, and operational controls. Every editable row below is a stored, validated setting.
settings.generalSubtitle: Platform identity, language, and regional defaults.
settings.digestEnabledDescription: Send the periodic system digest. The interval is configured below.
settings.verifiedPublishDescription: Only verified, active organizations can publish opportunities. This rule is enforced by the server and cannot be changed here.
settings.requireVerifiedEmailDescription: Block accounts with an unverified email from authenticated actions. Only applies when the server requires email verification.
settings.suspendOnReportLabel: Suspend target when a report resolves plainly
settings.suspendOnReportDescription: When a report is resolved without an explicit action, suspend the reported user or organization. Otherwise the report resolves plainly.
settings.publishGateDescription: An organization cannot publish while this many of its opportunities have submissions awaiting review.
settings.platformSubtitle: Live operational state and access switches.
settings.registrationDescription: Allow new volunteers and organizations to register. Turning this off blocks new sign-ups; existing sessions are unaffected.
settings.publishingDescription: Allow verified organizations to publish opportunities.
settings.sessionDurationDescription: How long an administrator session lasts, in whole days (1–90).
settings.dangerSubtitle: Consequential actions. Each one requires confirmation and takes effect immediately.
settings.disableRegDescription: Temporarily prevent new volunteers and organizations from registering. Existing sessions remain unaffected.
settings.maintenanceDangerDescription: Show a maintenance screen on public pages. Administrative access remains active.
settings.invalidValue: This value is not valid for the selected key.
settings.maintenanceDescription: While maintenance is on, public reads return a 503 maintenance response. Admin routes stay usable.
settings.enforcedOn: Public reads currently return 503 maintenance responses. The system status endpoint stays reachable and reports maintenance as on.
settings.statusError: Could not read the system status.
